name: Point-Cloud Based CGH Calculation
definition: A CGH generation method where the scene is discretized into a set of points in 3D space; each point is treated as a light-emitting primitive, and the hologram is obtained by summing the contributions of all points on the acquisition plane.
summary: Point-Cloud Based CGH Calculation generates holograms by summing wavefields from discrete 3D points, avoiding complex mesh processing and large-scale FFTs to enable efficient hardware implementation.
